[SWS_BswM_00109]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406
⌈If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the routine shall check if the BSW
Mode Manager is initialized.
In case of an error, the BswM shall ignore the block
mode indication and report the error to the Default Error Tracer with the error code
BSWM_E_UNINIT.⌋
[SWS_BswM_00110]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the parameter CurrentBlockMode
shall be checked for being in the allowed range. In case of an error, the BswM shall
ignore the block mode indication and report the error to the Default Error Tracer with
the value BSWM_E_REQ_MODE_OUT_OF_RANGE.⌋
